map.SLE Disease Activity Index 2000，根据近10天内的: SLE Disease Activity Index 2000, assesses SLE disease activity by clinical manifestations within the past 10 days
map.SLEDAI-2K 总分 = 各临床表现计分之和：8 分项（癫痫发作、精神病、器: SLEDAI-2K total = sum of clinical item scores: 8-point (seizure, psychosis, organic brain syndrome, visual disturbance, cranial nerve lesion, lupus headache, CVA, vasculitis), 4-point (arthritis, myositis, urinary casts, hematuria, proteinuria, pyuria), 2-point (new rash, alopecia, mucosal ulcer, pleuritis, pericarditis, low complement, rising anti-dsDNA) and 1-point (fever, thrombocytopenia, leukopenia); ≤4 essentially inactive, 5-9 mild, 10-14 moderate, ≥15 severe.
map.提示：SLEDAI-2K基于近10天临床表现评分。\"2K\"版本允许持续性活动: Note: SLEDAI-2K scores by clinical manifestations within the past 10 days. The '2K' version allows persistent activity (e.g. rash, proteinuria) to be scored, while the original SLEDAI scores only new/relapsing. SLEDAI >10 suggests moderate-high activity, consider adjusting immunosuppression. SLEDAI-2K Responder Index (SRI) is commonly used in research. For clinical reference only.
map.关节炎2+新发皮疹2+蛋白尿4+补体降低2+抗dsDNA升高2 = 12，中重度: Arthritis 2 + new rash 2 + proteinuria 4 + low complement 2 + rising anti-dsDNA 2 = 12, moderate-severe activity, needs immunosuppression; renal weight high, check urine protein quantification.
map.近 10 天无活动项 → 0，维持治疗并监测补体/dsDNA。: No active items in past 10 days → 0, maintain therapy and monitor complement/dsDNA.
map.SLEDAI-2K 看近 10 天表现，发作频率按是否新发或复发计。: SLEDAI-2K looks at the past 10 days; episode frequency counts as new or relapsing.

map.系统性红斑狼疮SLEDAI-2K疾病活动度评分器，根据24项临床表现（神经精神、: Systemic lupus erythematosus SLEDAI-2K disease activity scorer assesses SLE activity by weighted scoring of 24 clinical manifestations (neuropsychiatric, renal, joint, skin, immune, etc.). A medical professional tool based on authoritative standards, for reference only.
